question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query: SELECT CASE WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item line' WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line' WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'More than one item line' ELSE 'Unknown item-line count' END AS order_group, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COUNT(*) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_2025_orders, AVG(ITEM_QUANTITY) AS avg_ordered_units_per_order FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN order_group = 'No item line' THEN 1 WHEN order_group = 'One item line' THEN 2 WHEN order_group = 'More than one item line' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
action.metrics: 2025 order count and share by item-line count; average ITEM_QUANTITY per order for each group
action.group_by: No item line, one item line, more than one item line

action.answer: Among 4,359,773 orders recorded in 2025, 3,052,089 had more than one item line: 70.005700% of orders. Average ordered units per order were 1.219753 for the 1,307,684 one-line orders and 3.484769 for the 3,052,089 multi-line orders. No-item-line orders: 0 (0.000000%).
